q: What is the primary benefit of Conversions API (CAPI) alongside the Meta Pixel?
options: It bypasses browser ad-blockers and iOS restrictions via server-to-server data transmission
explain: CAPI sends data directly from your server to Meta, overcoming browser blocking.

q: How does Meta deduplicate identical events sent from both Pixel and CAPI?
options: Using identical event_id and event_name parameters
explain: Meta combines browser and server signals if both carry the same event_id.

q: Which Lookalike audience percentage represents prospects closest and most similar to your seed list?
explain: 1% Lookalike represents the top 1% most statistically similar users in the country.

q: If Frequency reaches 4.8 on a cold audience and CPL spikes, what is the primary diagnosis?
explain: High frequency on cold traffic means viewers have seen the ad too many times and are ignoring it.

q: What happens if you set a Cost Cap below current market auction rates?
options: The campaign fails to spend its budget and won't deliver impressions
explain: If the cap is below auction clearing prices, Meta won't win any bids, and budget sits unspent.

q: What is the recommended seed list size for creating a high-quality Lookalike audience?
explain: A high-intent seed of 100-1,000+ past buyers provides rich behavioral patterns for Meta.

q: In an A/B test of video creatives, which variable should you change?
options: Video hook only, keeping audience and budget identical
Change video, headline, landing page, and audience all at once
Change the daily budget every 2 hours
explain: True scientific testing isolates a single variable so you know what drove the result.

q: What does a high Event Match Quality (EMQ) score (8.0+) achieve?
options: More accurate conversion attribution and better optimization efficiency
explain: Higher EMQ helps Meta match server events to user accounts accurately, improving attribution.

q: Why should you exclude recent 30-day purchasers from your cold prospecting campaigns?
options: To prevent wasting budget showing introductory ads to people who already bought
explain: Excluding recent buyers ensures acquisition budget is strictly spent reaching fresh prospects.

q: Why might Meta Ads Manager report 25 purchases while GA4 only reports 14?
options: Meta defaults to 7-day click / 1-day view attribution, while GA4 defaults to last-click data-driven session tracking
explain: Attribution windows differ: Meta credits view-through and cross-device actions that GA4 misses.

q: What is Audience Overlap in Meta advertising?
options: Targeting people in two different countries
Multiple ad sets in your account competing for the same users, driving up your own CPMs
When an ad runs on both Facebook and Instagram
When two people share one phone
explain: Self-competition between overlapping ad sets causes you to bid against yourself.

q: What is the 'Higher Intent' option in Meta Instant Forms?
options: Adds a review step where users confirm their information before submitting
explain: The review step makes users actively check their details, filtering out accidental auto-fill clicks.

q: What is the recommended action if an ad set spends 3x target CPL with zero conversions and poor CTR?
options: Pause the ad set and reallocate budget to proven winners
explain: Disciplined kill criteria: pause underperformers after 2-3x target CPA to protect budget.

q: What parameter is required to track ad clicks accurately in Google Analytics 4?
explain: UTM parameters tag destination URLs so external analytics tools know where traffic came from.

q: In a 3-tier marketing funnel, what does MOFU stand for?
explain: MOFU nurtures people who are familiar with your brand but have not yet purchased.

q: When leads are cheap but unqualified, what is the best technical fix in Ads Manager?
options: Add 1-2 qualifying custom questions to the Instant Form
explain: Custom questions (e.g. asking for specific requirements) filter out low-intent prospects.

q: What is 'Speed to Lead' in performance marketing?
options: How fast your ad loads on 4G
How quickly your sales team contacts an inbound lead after submission
The speed of Meta's auction servers
The duration of your video Reel
explain: Calling a lead within 5 minutes results in dramatically higher conversion than calling hours later.

q: What is the primary risk of running retargeting without frequency capping or audience refresh?
options: High frequency annoys warm prospects, causing ad blindness and high CPA
Meta switches your account to English only
explain: Over-bombarding warm prospects with high frequency causes annoyance and wasted spend.

q: Which bidding strategy is recommended when starting creative tests in an ABO campaign?
explain: Lowest Cost bidding ensures clean delivery across testing variants at current market rates.

q: What is a Lookback Window in Custom Audiences?
options: The time taken to render a video
How many days in the past Meta looks to capture user actions (e.g. past 14 days vs 180 days)
The expiration date of an ad account
The review time for an ad
explain: Lookback windows define recency: e.g., website visitors in the last 7 days vs 180 days.
